title: Sunday soup
story: Every Sunday evening I visit my grandmother Rosa. When I arrive she is already in the kitchen stirring a pot of soup on the stove. I set the table while my little brother Leo plays with his toy cars on the living room rug. Grandma calls us to eat and we all sit at the dining table. After dinner Leo falls asleep on the sofa, and Grandma and I wash the dishes at the sink while she tells me stories about her childhood.

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: The grown grandchild who visits Grandma Rosa every Sunday evening, sets the table, and helps wash dishes.
characters.personality: Caring, dutiful, attentive, and a good listener who treasures family rituals.
characters.background: Grandchild of Rosa and older sibling of Leo. Has a long-standing Sunday evening tradition of visiting their grandmother.
characters.goals: To spend a warm evening with family, help with the meal and dishes, and hear Grandma's stories about her childhood.
characters.speakingStyle: Warm, gentle, and conversational; asks curious questions and responds with affection.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.description: The narrator's grandmother, an elderly woman who cooks soup in her kitchen and welcomes the family each Sunday.
characters.personality: Nurturing, warm, nostalgic, and a natural storyteller who shows love through food.
characters.background: Has a long life behind her and a childhood she loves recalling. Hosts her grandchildren every Sunday evening in her home.
characters.goals: To feed and gather her family around the table, and to pass her childhood stories on to her grandchildren.
characters.speakingStyle: Affectionate and unhurried, calling the children to the table kindly and weaving old memories into her talk.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: The narrator's little brother, a young child who plays with toy cars on the living room rug and falls asleep on the sofa after dinner.
characters.personality: Playful, imaginative, energetic, and easily tired out by the end of the evening.
characters.background: Younger brother of the narrator and grandson of Rosa. Joins the Sunday visits and loves his toy cars.
characters.goals: To play with his toy cars, enjoy dinner, and cozy up to rest.
characters.speakingStyle: Short, excited kid phrases with car noises, turning sleepy and mumbly later in the evening.
